Headings: Refined Interiors, Uniquely Crafted for Every Vision Cheshire & Manchester | At Katherine Malouf Design Office, we believe exceptional interiors are born from pure collaboration and an uncompromising eye for detail. Serving discerning clients across Cheshire and Manchester, KMDO delivers comprehensive interior architecture and design services shaped around singular, individual visions. ​ Our practice encompasses every phase of the creative and execution process—from spatial concept design and bespoke furniture specification to lighting design and project management. Rather than applying a repetitive style, we approach every room, texture, and architectural detail with fresh curiosity. The result is a portfolio of distinct residential, retail, and hospitality spaces that feel deeply personal and effortlessly refined. ​ Based in the North West and drawing on extensive global experience, our studio acts as a trusted partner throughout the entire renovation journey. We support and guide our clients through every decision and site detail, removing the stress of complex builds to make the process seamless and inspiring. From Wilmslow, Knutsford, and Altrincham to Alderley Edge and central Manchester, we create harmonious spaces crafted with absolute peace of mind.
